description: Bulk BN G0W0 with spin-orbit coupling. Grounded in the LibRPA BN SOC regression cases.

nfreq.per_system_override_rule: nFreq 6 matches the upstream BN SOC regression.
nfreq.rationale: The upstream BN SOC case validates nfreq=6.

screening_kgrid.per_system_override_rule: Use the upstream 1x1x2 Gamma mesh for the fast SOC check.
screening_kgrid.rationale: The BN SOC regression uses a 1x1x2 mesh.

basis_family.per_system_override_rule: Use the ONCV PBE PP with the matched orbital set.
basis_family.rationale: Matches the upstream BN SOC case.

nao_family.rationale: Matches the upstream BN SOC orbital set.

exx_cs_inv_thr.per_system_override_rule: Automatic default is fine for light-element BN even with SOC.

shrink_threshold.per_system_override_rule: The BN SOC case uses a looser exx_pca_threshold 1e-2 because SOC doubles the state space.
shrink_threshold.rationale: The upstream BN SOC case sets exx_pca_threshold 1e-2.
